payload.summary: InboxRecord is an unchecked JSON.parse cast, so one malformed inbox file silently empties the whole ledger inbox
payload.detail: src/lib/developer-area/ledger-snapshot.ts:115 does JSON.parse(raw) as InboxRecord inside one try/catch that returns [] for the whole directory; no schema exists. Next action: add an inboxRecordSchema and safeParse per file so one bad record is skipped (and logged) rather than emptying the queue.
